facts.headline: DeFAI Explained: How AI Is Transforming Decentralized Finance
facts.summary: DeFAI—Decentralized Finance AI—combines DeFi's permissionless infrastructure with AI's ability to automate strategy and execution. This explainer covers what DeFAI is, how AI is used across DeFi, and why handing financial judgment to autonomous agents is as risky as it is powerful.
